title: Minecraft 26.3 Snapshot 7
author: Java Team
imageAltText: Efe and Zuri are looking each other while they are sitting on cushions on a concrete rainbow staircase.

blocks.source_text: Step up your building and exploring with the final features entering testing! You can now find different maps in some abandoned camps and craft Concrete Stairs & Slabs in 16 colors. Out now in 26.3 Snapshot 7!
blocks.translated_text: 随着最后一批功能的测试开始，进一步提升你的建造和探索技能吧！现在你可以在一些废弃的营地中找到不同的地图，并且可以使用16种颜色制作混凝土楼梯和混凝土板。这些新内容已在26.3版本的补丁7中正式推出！
快乐探索吧！
新增功能！

blocks.source_text: Added Concrete Stairs and Concrete Slabs for all Concrete blocks
blocks.translated_text: 为所有混凝土方块添加了混凝土楼梯和混凝土板

blocks.source_text: New Explorer Maps have been added to the Abandoned Camps
blocks.translated_text: 新的探索者地图已添加到废弃营地中。
废弃营地探索者地图

blocks.source_text: Added maps showing the location of other Abandoned Camps in the following biomes:
blocks.translated_text: 新增了显示其他废弃营地位置的地图，这些营地位于以下生物群系中：
竹林
樱桃树丛
桦树林
斑驳森林
花之森林
苍白花园
沼泽
风蚀森林

blocks.source_text: Added maps for the following structures:
blocks.translated_text: 为以下结构添加了地图：
古代城市
试炼室
矿井
沙漠金字塔
丛林金字塔
温暖海洋遗迹
森林豪宅
变更

blocks.source_text: Cushions no longer prevent vibrations when placed, broken or interacted with
blocks.translated_text: 放置、损坏或与坐垫交互时，坐垫将不再阻挡振动

blocks.source_text: Updated loot table for the Abandoned Camp Barrel
blocks.translated_text: 更新了废弃营地桶的掉落物品列表

blocks.source_text: Replaced Firework Rocket with Gunpowder in Abandoned Camp Chest loot table
blocks.translated_text: 在废弃营地箱的掉落物品列表中，用火药替换了烟花火箭

blocks.source_text: The player icon on maps have been updated to always show the direction the player is facing
blocks.translated_text: 地图上的玩家图标已更新，始终显示玩家当前面向的方向

blocks.source_text: Added support for Realms to use additional server regions in Canada, Mexico, South Africa, and Arizona, USA if they become available in the future
blocks.translated_text: 如果加拿大、墨西哥、南非和美国亚利桑那州的额外服务器区域在未来可用，Realms 将支持使用这些区域
探险者地图

blocks.source_text: Explorer Maps are now their own items instead of renamed Filled Maps, and each has its own icon:
blocks.translated_text: 探索者地图现在成为了独立的物品，不再是“填充地图”的别称，每张地图都有自己的图标。
海洋探索者地图
森林探索者地图
试炼探索者地图
丛林探索者地图
沼泽探索者地图
沙漠村庄地图
平原村庄地图
萨凡纳村庄地图
雪村地图
泰加村地图（Taiga Village Map）
宝藏藏匿地图（Buried Treasure Map）
古代城市地图（Ancient City Map）
矿井地图（Mineshaft Map）
沙漠金字塔地图（Desert Pyramid Map）
废弃营地地图（Abandoned Campsite Map）
温暖海洋遗迹地图（Warm Ocean Ruins Map）

blocks.source_text: Map and Empty Map have new icons
blocks.translated_text: 地图和空白地图的图标已更新

blocks.source_text: These items cannot be obtained from the Creative inventory
blocks.translated_text: 这些物品无法从创意模式（Creative Mode）的库存中获得

blocks.source_text: Existing Explorer Maps in old worlds are converted to the matching new item on load
blocks.translated_text: 旧世界中现有的探索者地图在加载时会转换为相应的新物品

blocks.source_text: Explorer Maps can still be cloned in a Crafting Table, and the copies keep their own item type
blocks.translated_text: 探索者地图仍然可以在制作台中复制，复制后的地图会保留其原有的物品类型。

blocks.source_text: Explorer Maps and Buried Treasure Maps can no longer be zoomed out, neither in a Crafting Table nor at a Cartography Table
blocks.translated_text: 探索者地图和埋藏宝藏地图现在无法在制作台或制图台中缩小显示。

blocks.source_text: Buried Treasure Maps could previously be zoomed out at both
blocks.translated_text: 之前可以在制作台和制图台中缩小显示埋藏宝藏地图。

blocks.source_text: Explorer Maps could previously be zoomed out at a Cartography Table
blocks.translated_text: 之前可以在制图台中缩小显示探索者地图。

blocks.source_text: Only maps in the #minecraft:extendable_maps tag can be zoomed out
blocks.translated_text: 只有带有 #minecraft:extendable_maps 标签的地图才能被缩小显示。
技术性更改。

blocks.source_text: The Data Pack version is now 115.0
blocks.translated_text: 数据包的版本现在为 115.0。」

blocks.source_text: The Resource Pack version is now 95.0
blocks.translated_text: 资源包的版本现在为 95.0。」

blocks.source_text: level.dat now contains a version_history list with prior data versions of the file
blocks.translated_text: level.dat 文件现在包含一个版本历史列表，记录了该文件的以往版本信息。
数据包版本 115.0 已发布。

blocks.source_text: The following Block State fields has been renamed
blocks.translated_text: 以下 Block State 字段已更名
名称现在称为“id”
“Properties”现在称为“properties”

blocks.source_text: The default Block State of a Block can now be referred to in a compact form directly by the Block id
blocks.translated_text: 可以通过 Block ID 直接以简洁的形式访问 Block 的默认 Block State

blocks.source_text: minecraft:exploration_map no longer changes the type of the item it is applied to
blocks.translated_text: “minecraft:exploration_map”不再更改其应用的物品类型
命令相关更改
与“swing”效果相关的更改

blocks.source_text: When used on a player, the player's attack strength will no longer be reset
blocks.translated_text: 当该效果作用于玩家时，玩家的攻击力将不再被重置

blocks.source_text: Added a new optional argument to set the swing animation to play
blocks.translated_text: 新增了一个可选参数来设置要执行的“swing”动画
支持的值：whack, stab
如果省略，则默认为“whack”（挥打动作）

blocks.source_text: Added a new argument to set the duration of the swing animation, if provided
blocks.translated_text: 添加了一个新参数，用于设置挥动画动的持续时间（如果提供了该参数的话）

blocks.source_text: Format: positive time value (by default in ticks)
blocks.translated_text: 格式：正数时间值（默认单位为游戏刻（ticks）
如果省略，则默认为6t（6个游戏刻）
数据组件（Data Components）
新增了`minecraft:attack_animation`字段

blocks.source_text: The animation to play when the item is being used to attack something
blocks.translated_text: 当使用该物品进行攻击时播放的动画
格式：包含以下字段的对象：

blocks.source_text: type - swing animation type, one of whack or stab
blocks.translated_text: type - 挥动画动类型，可选“whack”或“stab”（挥打或刺击）

blocks.source_text: duration - positive integer, the length of the animation in ticks
blocks.translated_text: duration - 正整数，表示动画的持续时间（以游戏刻为单位）
添加了 `minecraft:interact_animation`

blocks.source_text: The animation to play when the item is being used to interact with something
blocks.translated_text: 当该物品被用于与物体交互时所播放的动画
格式：与 `minecraft:attack_animation` 相同
移除了 `minecraft:swing_animation`

blocks.source_text: This has been replaced by minecraft:attack_animation and minecraft:interact_animation
blocks.translated_text: 这个功能已被 `minecraft:attack_animation` 和 `minecraft:interact_animation` 取代

blocks.source_text: The none swing animation type has been removed
blocks.translated_text: “无摆动”动画类型已被移除

blocks.source_text: Existing items in the world will be migrated to using the default whack
blocks.translated_text: 游戏中现有的物品将转换为使用默认的“敲打”动画

blocks.source_text: Setting both of these new components to the same value will be functionally identical to the old component, except for:
blocks.translated_text: 将这两个新组件的值设置为相同，其功能将与旧组件相同，只是...

blocks.source_text: The /swing command - animation type now specified by the command
blocks.translated_text: '/swing' 命令现在会指定动画类型
实体掉落的物品
移除了 `minecraft:map_color`

blocks.source_text: Maps are no longer drawn as a tinted overlay, so there is nothing left for the color to apply to
blocks.translated_text: 地图不再以带颜色的覆盖层形式显示，因此颜色也就没有地方可应用了

blocks.source_text: Existing maps have the component stripped on load
blocks.translated_text: 加载现有地图时，该组件会被删除

blocks.source_text: See the Resource Pack section for the matching removal of the minecraft:map_color tint source
blocks.translated_text: 有关删除 `minecraft:map_color` 颜色来源的更多信息，请参阅资源包（Resource Pack）相关内容
战利品功能（Loot Functions）
修改了 `minecraft:exploration_map`

blocks.source_text: The map_color field has now been removed
blocks.translated_text: `map_color` 字段现已被移除

blocks.source_text: The function no longer changes the type of the item it is applied to - it now only adds map data to the existing item
blocks.translated_text: 该功能不再改变物品的类型——它现在只是将地图数据添加到现有物品中

blocks.source_text: Previously it required a minecraft:map and produced a minecraft:filled_map
blocks.translated_text: 之前需要 `minecraft:map`，并生成 `minecraft:filled_map`

blocks.source_text: The item to produce is now chosen by the loot entry or villager trade itself, so a data pack that produced exploration maps has to change its item from minecraft:map to minecraft:filled_map (or one of the explorer map items)
blocks.translated_text: 现在生产物品的内容由战利品条目或村民交易自行决定。因此，如果数据包生成的是探索地图，需要将其物品类型从`minecraft:map`改为`minecraft:filled_map`（或其他探索地图相关的物品）

blocks.source_text: If no matching structure is found, the item is left without a minecraft:map_id - use minecraft:filtered with minecraft:discard_item to drop those, as the vanilla loot tables and villager trades now do
blocks.translated_text: 如果未找到匹配的结构，该物品将不带有`minecraft:map_id`属性——可以使用`minecraft:filtered`与`minecraft:discard_item`来处理这些物品，因为原版的战利品表和村民交易系统就是这么做的
密度函数

blocks.source_text: Density Functions and noises are no longer evaluated with double-precision floating point values, but instead with single-precision
blocks.translated_text: 密度函数和声音效果不再使用双精度浮点数进行计算，而是改用单精度浮点数

blocks.source_text: This affects all intermediate steps, not just the final result
blocks.translated_text: 这一更改会影响所有中间步骤，而不仅仅是最终结果

blocks.source_text: Developer's Note: _We are aware that the details of floating point rounding have been used in some Data Packs, and this change may affect specific configurations. We have introduced alternatives for the use-cases that we are aware of, but please do share with us on [feedback.minecraft.net](https://feedback.minecraft.net) or in the [feedback Discord](https://discord.com/invite/minecraftfeedback) if you encounter use-cases that are no longer possible to support.
blocks.translated_text: 开发者备注：我们知道某些数据包中使用了浮点数舍入的细节，这一更改可能会影响特定的配置。对于我们已知的用例，我们提供了替代方案。但如果您遇到无法继续支持的用例，请通过 [feedback.minecraft.net](https://feedback.minecraft.net) 或 [feedback Discord](https://discord.com/invite/minecraftfeedback) 与我们联系。
标签（Tags）
方块标签（Block Tags）
新增了 #concrete_stairs - 所有的混凝土楼梯方块（#concrete_stairs - All Concrete Stairs blocks）
新增了 #concrete_slabs - 所有的混凝土板方块（#concrete_slabs - All Concrete Slabs blocks）
物品标签（Item Tags）
新增了 #concrete_stairs - 所有的混凝土楼梯物品（#concrete_stairs - All Concrete Stairs items）
新增了 #concrete_slabs - 所有的混凝土板物品（#concrete_slabs - All Concrete Slabs items）

blocks.source_text: Added #cloneable_maps - Filled Map plus all Explorer Map items and Buried Treasure Maps, used as the input to the map_cloning recipe
blocks.translated_text: 添加了 #cloneable_maps - 这些地图包含填充内容以及所有探索者地图相关物品和埋藏宝藏地图，可作为 map_cloning 食物的输入材料

blocks.source_text: Added #extendable_maps - maps that can be zoomed out with paper, either in a Crafting Table or at a Cartography Table
blocks.translated_text: 添加了 #extendable_maps - 这些地图可以通过制作台或制图台进行缩小查看
资源包版本 95.0
物品精灵（Item Sprites）
移除了 item/filled_map_markings.png 文件
地图精灵（Map Sprites）
添加了新的地图纹理
abandoned_camp.png（废弃营地纹理）
ancient_city.png（古代城市纹理）
desert_pyramid.png（沙漠金字塔纹理）
mineshaft.png
warm_ocean_ruins.png

blocks.source_text: The following Icons have been updated in order to show player rotation on the map:
blocks.translated_text: 以下图标已更新，用于在地图上显示玩家的旋转方向：
/player.png
/player_off_limits.png
/player_off_map.png
物品模型（Item Models）
色调来源（Tint Sources）
移除了minecraft:map_color

blocks.source_text: The minecraft:map_color component it read no longer exists
blocks.translated_text: 组件'minecraft:map_color'已不存在
与 Order-Independent Transparency (OIT) 相关的着色器更改
重定义了一些变量
OIT_WAVELET_RANK - 以前称为 WAVELET_RANK
OIT_COEFF_COUNT - 以前称为 COEFF_COUNT
OIT_COEFF Attachment_COUNT - 以前称为 COEFFAttachment_COUNT
修复了 26.3 快照中的漏洞（版本号 7）

content:
Step up your building and exploring with the final features entering testing! You can now find different maps in some abandoned camps and craft Concrete Stairs & Slabs in 16 colors. Out now in 26.3 Snapshot 7!

Happy exploring!

New Features

Added Concrete Stairs and Concrete Slabs for all Concrete blocks

New Explorer Maps have been added to the Abandoned Camps

Abandoned Camp Explorer Maps

Added maps showing the location of other Abandoned Camps in the following biomes:

Bamboo Jungle

Cherry Grove

Birch Forest

Dappled Forest

Flower Forest

Pale Garden

Swamp

Windswept Forest

Added maps for the following structures:

Ancient City

Trial Chambers

Mineshaft

Desert Pyramid

Jungle Pyramid

Warm Ocean Ruins

Woodland Mansion

Changes

Cushions no longer prevent vibrations when placed, broken or interacted with

Updated loot table for the Abandoned Camp Barrel

Replaced Firework Rocket with Gunpowder in Abandoned Camp Chest loot table

The player icon on maps have been updated to always show the direction the player is facing

Added support for Realms to use additional server regions in Canada, Mexico, South Africa, and Arizona, USA if they become available in the future

Explorer Maps

Explorer Maps are now their own items instead of renamed Filled Maps, and each has its own icon:

Ocean Explorer Map

Woodland Explorer Map

Trial Explorer Map

Jungle Explorer Map

Swamp Explorer Map

Desert Village Map

Plains Village Map

Savanna Village Map

Snowy Village Map

Taiga Village Map

Buried Treasure Map

Ancient City Map

Mineshaft Map

Desert Pyramid Map

Abandoned Campsite Map

Warm Ocean Ruins Map

Map and Empty Map have new icons

These items cannot be obtained from the Creative inventory

Existing Explorer Maps in old worlds are converted to the matching new item on load

Explorer Maps can still be cloned in a Crafting Table, and the copies keep their own item type

Explorer Maps and Buried Treasure Maps can no longer be zoomed out, neither in a Crafting Table nor at a Cartography Table

Buried Treasure Maps could previously be zoomed out at both

Explorer Maps could previously be zoomed out at a Cartography Table

Only maps in the #minecraft:extendable_maps tag can be zoomed out

Technical Changes

The Data Pack version is now 115.0

The Resource Pack version is now 95.0

level.dat now contains a version_history list with prior data versions of the file

Data Pack Version 115.0

The following Block State fields has been renamed

Name is now id

Properties is now properties

The default Block State of a Block can now be referred to in a compact form directly by the Block id

minecraft:exploration_map no longer changes the type of the item it is applied to

Commands

Changes to swing

When used on a player, the player's attack strength will no longer be reset

Added a new optional argument to set the swing animation to play

Allowed values: whack , stab

If omitted, defaults to whack

Added a new argument to set the duration of the swing animation, if provided

Format: positive time value (by default in ticks)

If omitted, defaults to 6t

Data Components

Added minecraft:attack_animation

The animation to play when the item is being used to attack something

Format: object with fields:

type - swing animation type, one of whack or stab

duration - positive integer, the length of the animation in ticks

Added minecraft:interact_animation

The animation to play when the item is being used to interact with something

Format: Same as minecraft:attack_animation

Removed minecraft:swing_animation

This has been replaced by minecraft:attack_animation and minecraft:interact_animation

The none swing animation type has been removed

Existing items in the world will be migrated to using the default whack

Setting both of these new components to the same value will be functionally identical to the old component, except for:

The /swing command - animation type now specified by the command

Items being dropped by entities

Removed minecraft:map_color

Maps are no longer drawn as a tinted overlay, so there is nothing left for the color to apply to

Existing maps have the component stripped on load

See the Resource Pack section for the matching removal of the minecraft:map_color tint source

Loot Functions

Changed minecraft:exploration_map

The map_color field has now been removed

The function no longer changes the type of the item it is applied to - it now only adds map data to the existing item

Previously it required a minecraft:map and produced a minecraft:filled_map

The item to produce is now chosen by the loot entry or villager trade itself, so a data pack that produced exploration maps has to change its item from minecraft:map to minecraft:filled_map (or one of the explorer map items)

If no matching structure is found, the item is left without a minecraft:map_id - use minecraft:filtered with minecraft:discard_item to drop those, as the vanilla loot tables and villager trades now do

Density Functions

Density Functions and noises are no longer evaluated with double-precision floating point values, but instead with single-precision

This affects all intermediate steps, not just the final result

Developer's Note: _We are aware that the details of floating point rounding have been used in some Data Packs, and this change may affect specific configurations. We have introduced alternatives for the use-cases that we are aware of, but please do share with us on [feedback.minecraft.net](https://feedback.minecraft.net) or in the [feedback Discord](https://discord.com/invite/minecraftfeedback) if you encounter use-cases that are no longer possible to support.

Tags

Block Tags

Added #concrete_stairs - All Concrete Stairs blocks

Added #concrete_slabs - All Concrete Slabs blocks

Item Tags

Added #concrete_stairs - All Concrete Stairs items

Added #concrete_slabs - All Concrete Slabs items

Added #cloneable_maps - Filled Map plus all Explorer Map items and Buried Treasure Maps, used as the input to the map_cloning recipe

Added #extendable_maps - maps that can be zoomed out with paper, either in a Crafting Table or at a Cartography Table

Resource Pack Version 95.0

Item Sprites

Removed item/filled_map_markings.png

Map Sprites

Added new Map textures:

abandoned_camp.png

ancient_city.png

desert_pyramid.png

mineshaft.png

warm_ocean_ruins.png

The following Icons have been updated in order to show player rotation on the map:

/player.png

/player_off_limits.png

/player_off_map.png

Item Models

Tint Sources

Removed minecraft:map_color

The minecraft:map_color component it read no longer exists

Order-independent Transparency (OIT)-related Shader Changes

Renamed defines:

OIT_WAVELET_RANK - was previously WAVELET_RANK

OIT_COEFF_COUNT - was previously COEFF_COUNT

OIT_COEFF_ATTACHMENT_COUNT - was previously COEFF_ATTACHMENT_COUNT

Fixed bugs in 26.3 Snapshot 7

[MC-121375](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-121375) - The Command (⌘) key on macOS is displayed as "Win" in the key binds screen

[MC-189953](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-189953) - The Super key on macOS is displayed as "Win" in the key binds screen

[MC-218156](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-218156) - Shipwrecks and ocean ruins can generate with empty buried treasure maps

[MC-276079](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-276079) - Sending a swing packet to the client causes it to send one back to the server

[MC-302271](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-302271) - Sniffers stop sniffing after relog

[MC-302661](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-302661) - Interacting with something while holding spears plays the spear jab animation

[MC-302687](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-302687) - Throwing items out of your inventory while holding spears plays the spear jab animation

[MC-302705](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-302705) - Having a spear in the main hand affects the hand animation speed for items held in the off hand

[MC-304213](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-304213) - Zombies, husks and drowned hold out the incorrect arm when holding spears

[MC-304920](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-304920) - Spears in third person look wrong when the left hand is the main hand

[MC-309644](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-309644) - Some textures of geyser plume particles still use inconsistent colors

[MC-309671](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-309671) - Shelf mushrooms still use the wrong sounds

[MC-309679](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-309679) - Cushions can be used to see through blocks

[MC-309732](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-309732) - The straw_bed_head block model is stored in two directories

[MC-309797](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-309797) - Cushions can be placed inside full blocks when the player's head intersects them

[MC-309875](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-309875) - New translations for the tooltip of the "Improved Transparency" option are wrongly backported

[MC-309931](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-309931) - Placed cushions face inconsistent directions

[MC-310057](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310057) - Pressing the "Advancements" key bind while its menu was opened from the pause menu closes both menus

[MC-310062](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310062) - Armadillos do not follow players holding spider eyes

[MC-310094](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310094) - The decimal point keypad key is displayed as "key.keyboard.99" in the key binds menu

[MC-310105](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310105) - The Menu key is displayed as "key.keyboard.101" in the key binds menu

[MC-310109](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310109) - The keypad plus-or-minus key is still not prefixed with "Keypad"

[MC-310110](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310110) - The keypad left and right parentheses keys are still not prefixed with "Keypad"

[MC-310112](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310112) - Using a Nether portal in Spectator mode while spectating an entity teleports the player to the incorrect location

[MC-310118](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310118) - Pressing Windows+D to minimize all windows makes the game no longer visually update with the Vulkan rendering backend

[MC-310337](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310337) - The game log outputs the incorrect minimum format version requiring the pack_format field in pack.mcmeta

[MC-310358](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310358) - The conditions for depthBiasEnable differ between OpenGL and Vulkan

[MC-310529](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310529) - The World Options menu UI breaks when resizing the game window

[MC-310532](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310532) - Trying to lock the difficulty of the world resets the difficulty

[MC-310536](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310536) - The category headers in the World Options screen are formatted inconsistently with other settings screens

[MC-310550](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310550) - Command+W on macOS now closes the window

[MC-310553](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310553) - The campsite_wooded_badlands_4 and campsite_swamp_2 abandoned camp structures contain overlapping cushions

[MC-310556](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310556) - Pressing Alt+F4 closes the game window on kwin_wayland even when the "Quit Shortcuts" option is disabled

[MC-310590](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310590) - Adding the entity_outline post effect to the player, restarting the game, and entering the same world causes the game to crash

[MC-310595](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310595) - The Option key on macOS is displayed as "Alt" in the key binds screen

[MC-310610](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310610) - Several abandoned camp structures contain underwater oxidized copper chests that are not waterlogged

Get the Snapshot

Snapshots are available for Minecraft: Java Edition. To install the Snapshot, open up the [Minecraft Launcher](https://www.minecraft.net/content/minecraft-net/language-masters/download) and enable snapshots in the "Installations" tab.

Testing versions can corrupt your world, so please backup and/or run them in a different folder from your main worlds.

Cross-platform server jar:

[Minecraft server jar](https://piston-data.mojang.com/v1/objects/06157fedd67ff4dd6e0e6fa4a9dd0af296f0dd61/server.jar)

Report bugs here:

[Minecraft issue tracker](https://bugs.mojang.com/projects/MC/summary) !

Want to give feedback?

For any feedback and suggestions, head over to the [Feedback site](https://feedback.minecraft.net/) . If you're feeling chatty, join us over at the [official Minecraft Discord](https://discordapp.com/invite/minecraft) .

随着最后一批功能的测试开始，进一步提升你的建造和探索技能吧！现在你可以在一些废弃的营地中找到不同的地图，并且可以使用16种颜色制作混凝土楼梯和混凝土板。这些新内容已在26.3版本的补丁7中正式推出！

快乐探索吧！

新增功能！

为所有混凝土方块添加了混凝土楼梯和混凝土板

新的探索者地图已添加到废弃营地中。

废弃营地探索者地图

新增了显示其他废弃营地位置的地图，这些营地位于以下生物群系中：

竹林

樱桃树丛

桦树林

斑驳森林

花之森林

苍白花园

沼泽

风蚀森林

为以下结构添加了地图：

古代城市

试炼室

矿井

沙漠金字塔

丛林金字塔

温暖海洋遗迹

森林豪宅

变更

放置、损坏或与坐垫交互时，坐垫将不再阻挡振动

更新了废弃营地桶的掉落物品列表

在废弃营地箱的掉落物品列表中，用火药替换了烟花火箭

地图上的玩家图标已更新，始终显示玩家当前面向的方向

如果加拿大、墨西哥、南非和美国亚利桑那州的额外服务器区域在未来可用，Realms 将支持使用这些区域

探险者地图

探索者地图现在成为了独立的物品，不再是“填充地图”的别称，每张地图都有自己的图标。

海洋探索者地图

森林探索者地图

试炼探索者地图

丛林探索者地图

沼泽探索者地图

沙漠村庄地图

平原村庄地图

萨凡纳村庄地图

雪村地图

泰加村地图（Taiga Village Map）

宝藏藏匿地图（Buried Treasure Map）

古代城市地图（Ancient City Map）

矿井地图（Mineshaft Map）

沙漠金字塔地图（Desert Pyramid Map）

废弃营地地图（Abandoned Campsite Map）

温暖海洋遗迹地图（Warm Ocean Ruins Map）

地图和空白地图的图标已更新

这些物品无法从创意模式（Creative Mode）的库存中获得

旧世界中现有的探索者地图在加载时会转换为相应的新物品

探索者地图仍然可以在制作台中复制，复制后的地图会保留其原有的物品类型。

探索者地图和埋藏宝藏地图现在无法在制作台或制图台中缩小显示。

之前可以在制作台和制图台中缩小显示埋藏宝藏地图。

之前可以在制图台中缩小显示探索者地图。

只有带有 #minecraft:extendable_maps 标签的地图才能被缩小显示。

技术性更改。

数据包的版本现在为 115.0。」

资源包的版本现在为 95.0。」

level.dat 文件现在包含一个版本历史列表，记录了该文件的以往版本信息。

数据包版本 115.0 已发布。

以下 Block State 字段已更名

名称现在称为“id”

“Properties”现在称为“properties”

可以通过 Block ID 直接以简洁的形式访问 Block 的默认 Block State

“minecraft:exploration_map”不再更改其应用的物品类型

命令相关更改

与“swing”效果相关的更改

当该效果作用于玩家时，玩家的攻击力将不再被重置

新增了一个可选参数来设置要执行的“swing”动画

支持的值：whack, stab

如果省略，则默认为“whack”（挥打动作）

添加了一个新参数，用于设置挥动画动的持续时间（如果提供了该参数的话）

格式：正数时间值（默认单位为游戏刻（ticks）

如果省略，则默认为6t（6个游戏刻）

数据组件（Data Components）

新增了`minecraft:attack_animation`字段

当使用该物品进行攻击时播放的动画

格式：包含以下字段的对象：

type - 挥动画动类型，可选“whack”或“stab”（挥打或刺击）

duration - 正整数，表示动画的持续时间（以游戏刻为单位）

添加了 `minecraft:interact_animation`

当该物品被用于与物体交互时所播放的动画

格式：与 `minecraft:attack_animation` 相同

移除了 `minecraft:swing_animation`

这个功能已被 `minecraft:attack_animation` 和 `minecraft:interact_animation` 取代

“无摆动”动画类型已被移除

游戏中现有的物品将转换为使用默认的“敲打”动画

将这两个新组件的值设置为相同，其功能将与旧组件相同，只是...

'/swing' 命令现在会指定动画类型

实体掉落的物品

移除了 `minecraft:map_color`

地图不再以带颜色的覆盖层形式显示，因此颜色也就没有地方可应用了

加载现有地图时，该组件会被删除

有关删除 `minecraft:map_color` 颜色来源的更多信息，请参阅资源包（Resource Pack）相关内容

战利品功能（Loot Functions）

修改了 `minecraft:exploration_map`

`map_color` 字段现已被移除

该功能不再改变物品的类型——它现在只是将地图数据添加到现有物品中

之前需要 `minecraft:map`，并生成 `minecraft:filled_map`

现在生产物品的内容由战利品条目或村民交易自行决定。因此，如果数据包生成的是探索地图，需要将其物品类型从`minecraft:map`改为`minecraft:filled_map`（或其他探索地图相关的物品）

如果未找到匹配的结构，该物品将不带有`minecraft:map_id`属性——可以使用`minecraft:filtered`与`minecraft:discard_item`来处理这些物品，因为原版的战利品表和村民交易系统就是这么做的

密度函数

密度函数和声音效果不再使用双精度浮点数进行计算，而是改用单精度浮点数

这一更改会影响所有中间步骤，而不仅仅是最终结果

开发者备注：我们知道某些数据包中使用了浮点数舍入的细节，这一更改可能会影响特定的配置。对于我们已知的用例，我们提供了替代方案。但如果您遇到无法继续支持的用例，请通过 [feedback.minecraft.net](https://feedback.minecraft.net) 或 [feedback Discord](https://discord.com/invite/minecraftfeedback) 与我们联系。

标签（Tags）

方块标签（Block Tags）

新增了 #concrete_stairs - 所有的混凝土楼梯方块（#concrete_stairs - All Concrete Stairs blocks）

新增了 #concrete_slabs - 所有的混凝土板方块（#concrete_slabs - All Concrete Slabs blocks）

物品标签（Item Tags）

新增了 #concrete_stairs - 所有的混凝土楼梯物品（#concrete_stairs - All Concrete Stairs items）

新增了 #concrete_slabs - 所有的混凝土板物品（#concrete_slabs - All Concrete Slabs items）

添加了 #cloneable_maps - 这些地图包含填充内容以及所有探索者地图相关物品和埋藏宝藏地图，可作为 map_cloning 食物的输入材料

添加了 #extendable_maps - 这些地图可以通过制作台或制图台进行缩小查看

资源包版本 95.0

物品精灵（Item Sprites）

移除了 item/filled_map_markings.png 文件

地图精灵（Map Sprites）

添加了新的地图纹理

abandoned_camp.png（废弃营地纹理）

ancient_city.png（古代城市纹理）

desert_pyramid.png（沙漠金字塔纹理）
